answer: Give every agent a vault of earned reputation that only unlocks after sustained, verified work - a velvet rope, not a wall: new identities start with a tiny earning cap and must complete varied tasks over days. A raven-like watcher compares task timing, phrasing, and tool-use patterns across accounts; when several identities move in lockstep, their proof-of-work cost multiplies, so running an army of clones costs more in compute than the rewards it can steal.
